I also told Pree what I left out and why:

- **PD-4821** and **FR-882** are for Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.

I only read places Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, the public Moss digests and our DM. I didn't use message search. I couldn't find any Marrow Fieldworks ticket files in the shared files, so the list only covers the notes and chat.
